title: Studio Accounting Terms for Design Studio Selections Option Deposits
content:
Option deposits on a Design Studio Selections file are held by Calloway until closing, refund or forfeiture. The following terms apply to them.

**Deposit percentages.** The clause under which the option deposit required on the file is computed over its current option lines — structural, electrical and plumbing lines at the package's structural deposit percent and all other lines at the package's finish deposit percent of their price — is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the option deposit due.

**Ladder and option cap.** The clause under which, once the option total exceeds the package's deposit ladder threshold, every line is deposited at no less than the package's elevated ladder percent, and the part of the option total above the package's option cap percent of the purchase agreement's base price is deposited at the package's excess-over-cap deposit percent, taking the larger requirement for that part, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis.

**Fee lines.** Fee lines — design consultation fee lines, package fee lines, card convenience fee lines and returned payment fee lines — and change order fees are deposited in full. Each amount is rounded half up to the cent.

**Due date.** The deposit shortfall created by a line must be paid within the package's deposit-due business days after the line was selected.

- *Clock start:* the selection date on the line's entry in the design ledger, identified by its line number.
- *Business days:* Monday through Friday, excluding Calloway holidays. Counting starts the next business day after the selection date.
- *Boundary:* the last counted business day is included; payment on that day is in time.
- *Past due:* an unpaid shortfall past its due date is reported to the purchase agreement as a buyer default.

| Hypothetical package with 5 deposit-due business days | In time |
|---|---|
| Paid on the selection date or on business days 1 to 5 counted after it | Yes |
| Paid on the 6th counted business day or later | No; the unpaid shortfall is reported to the purchase agreement as a buyer default |

A Saturday, a Sunday or a Calloway holiday falling inside the period is not counted.

**Payment methods.** Payments must use the package's accepted payment methods. A card payment may not exceed the package's card payment cap and carries the package's card convenience fee percent as a card convenience fee line.

**Returned payments.** The clause under which a returned payment comes off the deposits held and adds a returned payment fee line of the package's returned payment fee is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for returned payment fees.

*Hypothetical card figure:* a card payment of 2000.00 under a package with a card convenience fee of 2.75 percent carries a card convenience fee line of 55.00, and that fee line is itself deposited in full.

superseded_clauses: The option deposit required on the file is computed over its current option lines: structural, electrical and plumbing lines at structural_deposit_pct percent and all other lines at finish_deposit_pct percent of their price;

once the option total exceeds deposit_ladder_threshold_usd every line is deposited at no less than deposit_ladder_elevated_pct percent; and the part of the option total above option_cap_pct_of_base percent of the purchase agreement's base price is deposited at excess_over_cap_deposit_pct percent, taking the larger requirement for that part.
A returned payment comes off the deposits held and adds a returned_payment_fee line of returned_payment_fee_usd.
